name: tencent-cloud-quote-assistant
description: Tencent Cloud quote assistant for sales and solution teams. Supports product consultation and selection, real-time list-price quotes and comparisons, batch procurement quoting, competitor mapping, and discount guidance through controlled pricing workflows.

displayDescription.en: Tencent Cloud quote assistant for product consultation and selection, real-time list-price quotes and comparisons, batch procurement quoting, competitor mapping, discount guidance, and official-offer lookup. Formal prices come from controlled real-time pricing workflows.
displayDescription.zh: 面向销售与方案团队的腾讯云报价助手，支持产品咨询选型、实时刊例价查询比较、批量采购报价、友商 Mapping 与折扣推荐。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 腾讯云报价助手可以帮我做什么？
defaultInitPrompt.en: What can Tencent Cloud Quote Assistant help me with?

quickPrompts.en: What can Tencent Cloud Quote Assistant help me with?
quickPrompts.zh: 腾讯云报价助手可以帮我做什么？

quickPrompts.en: Compare the 1-year list prices of CVM 4C8G in Guangzhou and Shanghai
quickPrompts.zh: 对比 CVM 4核8G 在广州和上海购买一年的刊例价

quickPrompts.en: Map this Alibaba Cloud bill to Tencent Cloud products and then quote it
